2. Programming Interface

The CUDA programming interface supports compilation, memory management, and execution control.

2.1. Compilation

Source files containing CUDA C++ kernels are compiled with nvcc.

#include <iostream>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

template<typename T>
__global__ void scale(T* out, const T* in, T factor, int n) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < n) {
        out[idx] = in[idx] * factor;
    }
}

// compare operators preserved
bool check(int a, int b) {
    return a < b && b > a;
}
OptionDescription
-arch=sm_90Target SM 9.0 architecture.
--use_fast_mathUse faster but less precise intrinsics.
